overall: No violation found. The March 25 notice was sufficiently specific because the Eagle Hill houses discussion was not anticipated, and the cancelled full-Board site visit was not a violation. Older notice claims were untimely.

allegations.summary: Notice for the March 25 meeting allegedly was not specific enough, because the Board discussed four Eagle Hill School houses that the notice did not list.
allegations.key_passage: Because a discussion of the four houses was not reasonably anticipated 48 hours prior to the March 25 meeting, its omission does not render the meeting notice insufficiently specific.

allegations.summary: The Board allegedly scheduled an April 18 site visit attended by all members without posting notice of it as a meeting.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the Board cannot be found in violation of the Open Meeting Law where the site inspection by the full Board was cancelled.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged notices for meetings held July 2020 through February 2025 were insufficiently specific.
allegations.key_passage: To the extent that the complainant alleges that the notices of meetings held between July 14, 2020, and February 4, 2025, were insufficiently specific, those allegations are not timely and we do not review them.
